prompts.aelia: Production sprite sheet for existing game character Red-haired Aelia, preserve long red hair white flower, red skirt, brown bodice, white apron and sleeves. Reference 1 is existing character identity/costume/proportions to preserve. Reference 2 is mandatory pixel painting style ONLY, do not copy its characters or tavern. Generate EXACTLY 16 isolated full-body walking sprites in uniform 4 columns by 4 rows grid on genuinely transparent alpha. All cells equal size. Row 1 faces and walks diagonally UPPER LEFT, back-left three quarter, back of head visible. Row 2 UPPER RIGHT, back-right three quarter. Row 3 LOWER LEFT, front-left three quarter. Row 4 LOWER RIGHT, front-right three quarter. These four directions need visibly different facing, front/back, legs and arms, not a front-facing sprite sliding sideways. In EVERY row, columns are a seamless four-frame walk cycle: left foot forward/right arm forward; feet passing; right foot forward/left arm forward; feet passing. Both contact poses and two distinct passing poses. Tiny restrained natural step, stable head/body size and baseline, no jumping. Row-specific orientation remains constant through four frames. Clothes and hair subtly follow steps, no changes in identity/accessories. One character only. Modest compact management-game motion, crisp visible organized square pixel clusters stepped edges, no blurry/no smooth anime/no 3D. All complete head, hands and boots with generous transparent gutters, no row crossing, no duplication of faces or extra limbs, no labels/text/grid/borders. Each sprite centered in its cell; same scale and foot baseline across all 16. Square sheet.
